crossRefs.note: As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people were gathered together, both chief priests and scribes…
The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.
Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to…
and they bound him, and led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.
Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders and scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation…
The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up…
Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “You rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,
“For truly, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together against…
to do whatever your hand and your council foreordained to happen.
The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.
God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.
For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which…
